notes: Employment demand uses SHRUG's 2013 Economic Census city-wide workplace total for Hyderabad, redistributed using real 2011 Census GHMC ward-level worker counts. Only 99 of GHMC's ~144 wards had a matching Census figure — the other ~45 are mostly outer wards absorbed from Ranga Reddy district in 2007 that the 2011 Census never separately tabulated at GHMC ward level. For wards missing a Census figure, we substitute a modeled proxy weight built from that ward's own OSM landuse data, clearly distinguished from the real Census-derived weights; 27 of the 46 gap wards got a usable proxy, and 19 remain a documented residual limit with no landuse signal to draw on either. Jobs placed within wards via OSM building footprints by type; population and commute data follow the standard project pipeline. — Reviewer refinements (2026-09-10): workplace_granularity re-ruled adm2 — the measured workplace content is a single SHRUG EC13 city-wide total spanning the whole map (single units of ~4.5M-19M population: KMC ~4.5M, GHMC/Chennai Corp ~7M, BBMP ~8.4M, BMC ~12.4M, NCT Delhi ~19M — at or beyond the riyadh single-governorate scale, and NCT is simultaneously ADM1, the vienna middle-rule shape); the ward-level weights are residence-based Census PCA-TV worker counts, which are not measured workplace grain. Workplace placement re-priced osm_footprints x coarse_sector — the between-ward pattern is residence-weighted (reunion workers-land-where-people-live precedent, softened by a genuine within-ward signal) and the within-ward split is an OSM landuse/type sector prior. od_metric re-ruled prior_informed_synthetic — no per-area in/out commuter totals exist; only the origin marginal is measured (ward residence workers), the destination marginal is the single respread total, and the gravity decay is calibrated to Census 2011 Table B-28 distance bands — a genuinely domestic prior, better than the rung's analogue-country baseline, recorded as such. resident_granularity re-ruled mesh_1km — WorldPop is a modeled disaggregation, not a published census mesh: magnitudes are anchored over large areas but effective resolution after smoothing is on the order of a kilometre (the WorldPop rung, now on record). The honest 'spread evenly' placement answer stands as filed. workplace_count physical_measured CONFIRMED — the Economic Census is a real establishment enumeration (2013 vintage on record). 45 of ~144 GHMC wards lack a Census weight (27 use an OSM-landuse proxy, 19 have no signal) — documented residual.
